create.name: Dr. Cortland Dahl
create.bio:
Cortland Dahl is an American meditation teacher, translator of Tibetan Buddhist texts and contemplative scientist, and the co-founder and executive director of Tergar International, the worldwide network of meditation groups linked to Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche. He first turned to meditation as a student in the early 1990s, practised in Japan, Thailand and Malaysia, took a master's in Buddhist Studies at Naropa University, and then spent about eight years in Tibetan communities in Nepal and India. There he learned Tibetan, trained under three Tibetan lamas, among them Chatral Rinpoche and Mingyur Rinpoche, spent over a year in solitary retreat, later publishing twelve volumes of translations with a focus on Dzogchen.

With Mingyur Rinpoche he helped shape the Joy of Living meditation programme. In 2010 he moved to Madison, Wisconsin, to work with the neuroscientist Richard Davidson, earned one of the first doctorates in contemplative science there, and went on to design the Healthy Minds Program app. His books are A Meditator's Guide to Buddhism and, written with Davidson, Born to Flourish, which treats wellbeing as a trainable skill, and the two co-host the Dharma Lab podcast. He teaches workshops and retreats in Madison and further afield, and splits his time between Wisconsin and northern Minnesota with his wife Kasumi.

books.title: A Meditator's Guide to Buddhism
books.author: Cortland Dahl
books.description: A practice-led tour of the Buddhist path, from the Four Noble Truths through compassion and buddha nature to emptiness, with personal stories and simple meditations along the way.

books.title: Born to Flourish
books.author: Richard J. Davidson and Cortland Dahl
books.description: Written with the neuroscientist Richard Davidson, it argues from research and contemplative practice that wellbeing can be learned, and sets out a four-part framework with short daily exercises.

books.title: Deity, Mantra and Wisdom
books.author: Dharmachakra Translation Committee (Cortland Dahl, volume editor and co-translator)
books.description: Classic Tibetan writings on development-stage meditation in Buddhist tantra, translated with commentary; he edited the volume and shared the translation.

books.title: Middle Beyond Extremes
books.author: Dharmachakra Translation Committee (Cortland Dahl, volume editor and co-translator)
books.description: Maitreya's Madhyantavibhanga, a key Mahayana text on the middle way, in English together with two Tibetan commentaries, by Khenpo Shenga and by Ju Mipham.

free_resources.title: Open Awareness (guided meditation)
free_resources.description: A twenty-minute guided practice in letting effort go and simply resting in wide, open presence, shared on his site from Tergar's recordings.

free_resources.title: Awareness and the Senses (guided meditation)
free_resources.description: A guided session that uses sounds and sights as supports for steady, mindful awareness.

free_resources.title: Guided Meditation on Awareness of Thoughts
free_resources.description: A recorded practice in noticing thoughts as they come and go without being carried off by them.

free_resources.title: Tergar Madison Thursday Night Talks
free_resources.description: A free set of weekly talks recorded at Tergar Madison on meditation, the mind and Buddhist psychology in everyday life.
